title: QUIC RFC 9000 NEW_TOKEN Replay Enforcement Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home execution for listener-local NEW_TOKEN one-time acceptance, wider S8P1P3/S8P1P4 regression coverage, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and targeted no-build test execution.
scope: This verification covers listener-local replay prevention for valid NEW_TOKEN values used on future Initial connection attempts.
expected_result: The listener accepts the first valid NEW_TOKEN use as address validation, records the token as consumed, rejects a later Initial carrying the same token as replayed, and does not invoke the connection-options callback for the replay attempt when Retry bootstrap is enabled.
procedure: Run the focused S8P1P4 replay requirement-home filter.
Run the wider S8P1P3/S8P1P4 requirement-home regression filter.
preconditions: The listener uses the verifiable NEW_TOKEN envelope from ARC-QUIC-RFC9000-0034.
Retry bootstrap is enabled for the replay rejection proof.
Persistent or distributed replay state remains outside this verification scope.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim replay protection across listener restarts, cluster-wide replay coordination, public token policy, or Retry token source-address and source-port binding.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04. The Release build passed with zero warnings, the focused S8P1P4 replay filter passed 1/1, the wider S8P1P3/S8P1P4 no-build filter passed 42/42, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marked the four replay requirements trace_clean, and SpecTrace core validation passed for 349 JSON artifacts.
